request.description: Endpoint to recalculate the `ExpenseReviewProcess` a transaction is included into. This is particularly useful in case a change made on an `ExpenseReviewProcess` configuration should be applied to already existing transactions. In case a recalculated transaction is included into the same `ExpenseReviewProcess`, the transaction will remain assigned to the same approval step. This endpoint supports up to 100 transactions per single request.
